entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elf leader whose daughter was killed by an assassin and whom the Oracle told he would save his people by abandoning them.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Ascendant evincar of the Stronghold on Rath, who hungers for power and cruelty.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: A character on Rath who opposes Crovax and the Phyrexian machinery of the Stronghold.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A former ruler of the Stronghold who returns to reclaim what is his.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A character who offers to reveal secrets to Eladamri.

entities.name: Greven
entities.description: A person Volrath claims as his own.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard who marvels at life persisting in the Stronghold's core.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who speaks of the scourge of Skyshroud being airborne once more.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane whose denizens had never seen the moon before.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane whose ravages threaten Belbe.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The fortress on Rath controlled by the evincar, with a white-hot core.

entities.name: Rootwater
entities.description: The home of the Rootwater merfolk, dangerous to its denizens.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: A forest on Rath where elves live and flowstone spreads.

events.summary: Takara offers to show Eladamri the secrets she has seen.
events.quote: There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you.

events.summary: Volrath confronts Greven, claiming him as his own.
Crovax announces that things are going to change.
events.quote: Things are going to change around here.
destroyed what Eladamri loved most: his daughter.

events.summary: Crovax orders the enemy killed and fed to new recruits.
events.quote: Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits.
